//: Settings for SivaCommTest.exe. Keep this file beside the exe.
ClientId, KeyId and Secret are one of the Applications entries in the server's
appsettings.Production.json (e.g. Code hms-web and its Keys). The Secret is a real
signing secret: delete this file from the VM when you have finished testing.
//BaseUrl: On the VM itself: http://localhost:6073 (straight to the service).
//Phone: The WhatsApp number to send to, with country code, e.g. 919876543210. Can also be given on the command line.
//WelcomeParameters: One value per {{n}} in the application's Welcome template (Parameters in the server config).
